text: Crash deleting and recreating an SX with the scheduled transaction editor open

Created attachment 375152 [details]
Example of crash steps

GnuCash crashes when deleting and recreating a scheduled transaction with the scheduled transaction editor open.

1. Create a scheduled transaction from an existing transaction with the default settings
2. Open the scheduled transaction editor
3. Delete the scheduled transaction
4. Create the same scheduled transaction again

The recreated scheduled transaction must be for the same accounts and the editor must remain open. Step 1 can be performed in an earlier execution of the application.


The change in this commit is causing additional validation of an access to free'd memory when the SchedXaction* is cast retrieving it from the list:
